title: Harvest takes Apache-2.0 code only
goal: CEO vision 2026-11-12: Susi freely picks up features from any raw source in the cloud and integrates them into core and Commercial Apps, so core stays lean and Commercial Apps gets existing open-source innovation, with "only apache 2.0 license only for pure compliance". The harvest tooling existed (Mandate 74 section 5) but also admitted MIT, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause and `Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception`. `local-harvest` (scan, import, audit) and the distillation harvest audit (`harvest_spdx_allowed`) now admit Apache-2.0 only: a dual-licensed file is taken under its Apache-2.0 alternative; everything else is refused and nothing is written. No harvest manifest existed in either repository, so nothing already imported is affected. The dependency allowlist (Mandate 68) is a separate rule and is not changed.
limitations: License detection is still text and SPDX matching, not legal review (docs/harvest.md).
The MIT/BSD license-text fields of the manifest schema remain readable but are no longer produced.
No feature was harvested in this task: choosing a source is a product decision and fetching one is a separate, named step.
